text.tspan: Proof on a Linux bridge: pc1 pings pc2, and pc3 sees only the broadcast
→ flooded out of port2 AND port3
② ARP reply and the pings
unicast to MACs the bridge has just learned
pc3: not learned (it never sent a frame)
exactly ONE frame: the ARP request
(the broadcast); none of the ARP reply
or the pings, which were unicast
